title: Encoded MoE: scanned versus indexed column-major tiles

context.model: Synthetic encoded MoE component, not DeepSeek inference
context.representation: Q2_K encoded expert weights; Q8_K activations; unchanged exact integer products, F32 32-leaf reduction, BF16 publication and source-ordered F64 exceptional recovery
context.device: NVIDIA GB10; one device, coherent unified-memory domain; driver 580.159.03; CUDA toolkit 13.0.88; sm_121

arms.scan: Null compact-index pointer, retained prefix scan and output-row-major order
arms.indexed: Worklist-built compact tile index, column-major order; same kernel binary and arithmetic

runtime_configuration.sampling_policy: 12 rounds alternating AB/BA; discard first warmup round; 16 repetitions per GPU-event sample; 11 timed samples per arm
runtime_configuration.timer: CUDA events on owning stream, no CUPTI; builder plus one projection; setup and final downloads excluded
runtime_configuration.resource_observation: Advisory cuda-device lock; no QA build/test running during final timings; installed Host observed idle before/after, generation 3 preserved; not an uninterrupted exclusive operator reservation

context.workload: Real expert-major populations from (row*17 + rank*41) mod experts; top-k 6; gate/up 4096 -> 2048 with two packs; down 2048 -> 4096; no repeated-input population fabrication

memory.scope: Fixture CUDA allocation plus separate host buffers; not a model working-set observation. Phase index is already charged by workspace_required; do not add to RSS or overlapping capacity maxima.

limitations: Component characterization only: no DeepSeek checkpoint, artifact, binding, TTFT, committed decode or 2K/8K result is measured by this fixture.
Both arms execute the same frozen candidate binary; the control is the retained null-index scan. This is not a full-model before/after against an older executable.
Repeated synthetic encoded weights are warm and may be cache-hot; model mappings and actual model routing can change the benefit. No DRAM traffic, occupancy or cache hit rate was measured.
Independent decoded-weight F64 references and exact prior-kernel controls qualify bounded operations, not checkpoint conformance or held-out representation quality.
Target-only width-one execution retains the scalar path; this optimization does not establish a decode improvement or the 20/700 goals.
The installed operator Host and model stayed available. Sampled idle observations and an advisory lock do not establish a dedicated uninterrupted reservation.
All samples, dispersion, harness, source patch and raw hashes are retained. No universal optimum, automatic qualified recommendation or installed deployment follows.
